# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_secret (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_secret" "example_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_secret" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  credential_id = "182bd5e5-6e1a-4fe4-a799-aa6d9a6ab26e"
  password = "x"
  expires_at = "2019-12-27T18:11:19.117Z"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)
- `credential_id` (String) ID of the parent credential

### Optional

- `expires_at` (String) Optional deactivation deadline (RFC 3339). Omit or null for no expiry.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password stored only as a one-way hash and never returned. Maximum 72 UTF-8 bytes.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_basic_auth_secret.example '<account_id>/<credential_id>/<secret_id>'
```
